author: NASASpaceflight
description:
Launch window: May 1st from 1:33PM to 5:33PM EDT (17:33-21:33 UTC)
Current T0: May 1st at 1:33PM EDT (17:33 UTC)

Mission: Falcon 9 launch of 29 Starlink v2 Mini satellites into orbit.
Launch location: Space Launch Complex 40 (SLC-40), Cape Canaveral Space Force Station, Earth.
Target orbit: Low-Earth Orbit (LEO); 251x265kkm 53.16º orbit
Booster: B1069-31; 63d 5h 16min 50s turnaround
Past customer missions: CRS-24, Hotbird 13F, OneWeb-15, SES-18 & SES-19, 
Past Starlink missions: 4-23, 5-3, 5-6, 5-12, 6-9, 6-19, 6-28, 6-36, 6-39, 6-47, 6-57, 10-1, 10-9, 8-10, 10-8, 6-66, 12-3, 12-21, 6-74, 12-22, 10-23, 10-29, 10-57, 10-51, 6-96, 6-108.
Satellites launched: 805, will be 834 after this mission.
Booster recovery: A Shortfall Of Gravitas (ASOG)
Fairing recovery: Bob
Rocket trajectory: Northeast flying parallel to the US east coast
Payload mass: Approximately 17 tonnes.
Stats:
  - SpaceX's 662nd launch overall.
  - SpaceX's 53rd launch of the year.
  - SpaceX's 1st launch of the month.
